summary: POST /dialer/call (initiateCall) is pinned by Go tests: the CLI body keys, the MCP execute path body keys and route, and spec.yaml/upstream properties must equal a hard-coded list (to required); a reprint that renames a key or drops the required-to guard fails.
reason: The dialer initiate-call command has sent `to` since the #637 reprint (492db12). The small926-r1 side finding named a line (`toNumber` in dialer_initiate-call.go) that does not exist on main; `toNumber` occurs only in unrelated generated commands and types (at e8db03f: internal/cli/calls_create-record.go:96, internal/cli/messages_create.go:179, internal/cli/messages_send-sms.go:104, internal/types/types.go:1346, :2112, :2262). This record exists so the contract pin on POST /dialer/call survives reprints.
validated_outcome: Red when the command body key is renamed to toNumber, when the required-to guard is removed, and when the MCP route/query binding changes; green on main.
upstream_issue: To file against mvanhorn/cli-printing-press: none; this is a repo-local contract test.
